verdict.rationale: Aircall ships automations such as IVR routing, AI Agents and AI Assistants, so asking whether they can be versioned, reviewed and rolled back is fair. However, the evidence never documents version history, review or approval steps, or rollback for those automations. The URL-based API versioning and the separate development and production OAuth apps concern the developer API surface, not user automations, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
